findings.highlight: while I cut the tofu
findings.evidenceJa: タトン、タトン、と豆腐を切るなか
findings.governingReading: as the tofu is cut with repeated taton sounds
findings.explanation: The English removes the crisp repeated kitchen sound under Saber’s silent stare.

findings.highlight: Saber is sitting Japanese-style
findings.evidenceJa: 行儀よく正座したセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber sits properly in seiza
findings.explanation: A precise formal posture and its well-mannered quality become a vague cultural label.

findings.highlight: the results will be good enough if I go out on my own
findings.evidenceJa: 一人で外の様子を見る、というのもそれなりに成果はありそう
findings.governingReading: going alone to observe conditions outside seems likely to yield some result
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative prospect of useful information becomes confidence that the results will suffice.

findings.highlight: Saber insisted that it’s not going to be enough
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはそれでも安心できないと反論した
findings.governingReading: Saber objects that even so she cannot feel at ease
findings.explanation: The English removes Saber’s continuing personal concern and replaces it with an abstract sufficiency judgment.

findings.highlight: pissed me off
findings.evidenceJa: カチンときちまって
findings.governingReading: it irritates or nettles him
findings.explanation: mirror moon sharply coarsens Shirou’s internal register.

findings.highlight: Her glare feels like it’s burning into me
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの視線が痛いのは、言うまでもなくセイバーが怒っているからだ
findings.governingReading: Saber’s gaze hurts because, needless to say, she is angry
findings.explanation: The English adds burning imagery while removing the comic explicit causal explanation.

findings.highlight: I should be careful not to act stubborn again
findings.evidenceJa: 意地の張り合いにならないよう気をつけよう
findings.governingReading: he should avoid letting matters become another contest of stubbornness
findings.explanation: A lesson about mutual escalation becomes a unilateral fault in Shirou.

findings.highlight: inflexible blockhead
findings.evidenceJa: 融通きかない頑固もの
findings.governingReading: inflexible stubborn person
findings.explanation: The English adds an insult to Saber’s intelligence that Shirou does not use.

findings.highlight: she has sharp ears
findings.evidenceJa: 地獄耳だし
findings.governingReading: she has hellishly keen ears
findings.explanation: The English conveys good hearing but loses the comic Japanese idiom.

findings.highlight: the familiar tone of Sakura’s voice saying [say storage=sak0520_sak_0000]“excuse me”. voice.
findings.evidenceJa: 聞きなれた「お邪魔します」という桜の声
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s familiar voice saying “Excuse me”
findings.explanation: A leaked engine command, duplicated “voice,” and broken punctuation make the displayed sentence malformed.

findings.highlight: it seemed too much like bribery, so I changed my mind
findings.evidenceJa: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌なんで止めた
findings.governingReading: he abandons bread because it would look like currying favor with Saber
findings.explanation: Social appeasement becomes literal bribery, overstating Shirou’s comic resistance.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s gotten over it after one night
findings.evidenceJa: 桜も納得してくれたみたいだ
findings.governingReading: Sakura seems to have accepted the situation after a night
findings.explanation: Acceptance of Saber’s presence becomes recovery from an implied upset.

findings.highlight: German potato salad
findings.evidenceJa: ジャーマンポテト
findings.governingReading: German potato, the sautéed Japanese dish
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the prepared dish into potato salad.

findings.highlight: You’re elaborate this morning, cooking Western food
findings.evidenceJa: 朝から洋食風なんて凝ってますね
findings.governingReading: it is elaborate to make breakfast Western-style
findings.explanation: A Western-style touch becomes an assertion that Shirou is cooking Western food.

findings.highlight: the salad
findings.evidenceJa: 大量に作ったジャーマンポテト
findings.governingReading: the large quantity of German potato Shirou made
findings.explanation: The English omits the deliberately excessive amount of food.

findings.highlight: I’m just… proactively trying to clear the air between us
findings.evidenceJa: 単に少し日和っただけである
findings.governingReading: he merely chickened out or wavered a little
findings.explanation: mirror moon reverses Shirou’s embarrassed admission of weakness into flattering proactive diplomacy.

findings.highlight: That’s not… onion, is it
findings.evidenceJa: たまねぎの甘さじゃないですよね
findings.governingReading: that sweetness is not from the onion, is it
findings.explanation: Sakura distinguishes the source of sweetness; the English instead questions whether the ingredient is onion.

findings.highlight: when she’s so close, I can’t take my eyes off her
findings.evidenceJa: こんだけ近いと妙に艶かしい
findings.governingReading: at this distance the familiar gesture seems strangely sensual
findings.explanation: A quality Shirou suddenly perceives becomes an invented inability to avert his gaze.

findings.highlight: There’s nothing unusual about it
findings.evidenceJa: その仕草はいつもの桜だ
findings.governingReading: that gesture is the Sakura he knows as usual
findings.explanation: The specific gesture restoring Sakura’s familiar identity becomes a blanket claim that nothing is unusual.

findings.highlight: It should not concern Sakura even if Shinji was a Master or even if her family is a family of magi
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二がマスターで、間桐の家が魔術師の家系だとしても、それは桜には関係のない話
findings.governingReading: even if Shinji was a Master and the Matou were a magus lineage, that has nothing to do with Sakura
findings.explanation: The mature branch moves the next source page’s proposition onto page19, beginning a structurally different sequence.

findings.highlight: There’s a bruise on her right cheek, as if she’s been punched
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は
findings.governingReading: About Shinji—
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shirou’s aborted question with an unbound source-variant scene that gives Sakura a punched-looking cheek bruise.

findings.highlight: I, um, fell on the stairs
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が争いごとに巻き込まれる事はない
findings.governingReading: Sakura will not be drawn into the conflict
findings.explanation: The mature branch substitutes an unbound fall-on-the-stairs explanation for the active Japanese proposition.

findings.highlight: She’s been like this for a long time. She would be strangely lively or unnaturally depressed
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が争いごとに巻き込まれる事はない
findings.governingReading: Sakura will not be drawn into the conflict
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a history of Sakura covering for someone and marked mood changes absent from the bound Japanese source.

findings.highlight: It always meant Shinji was taking things out on her. When I first found out about it, I went and punched him
findings.evidenceJa: 何かの弾みで慎二が間桐家のこと、聖杯戦争のこと、マスター同士の戦いのことを桜にぶちまけてしまえば
findings.governingReading: if Shinji blurts out the Matou secret and Holy Grail War on some impulse
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the risk of secret disclosure with an unbound history of Shinji abusing Sakura and Shirou punching him.

findings.highlight: About half a year ago, I spotted a bruise on Sakura’s arm. I hit Shinji when I realized he’d done it[line3]but he’s never punched a girl’s face
findings.evidenceJa: それだけは避けなければ
findings.governingReading: that disclosure and involvement must be prevented
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts dated physical-abuse evidence and an escalation to striking Sakura’s face.

findings.highlight: It seems I broke the chopsticks in my hand
findings.evidenceJa: いや、なんでもない
findings.governingReading: No, it is nothing
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shirou withdrawing his question with an unbound anger beat and broken chopsticks.

findings.highlight: I told him never to hit his sister again, but he couldn’t keep such a simple promise
findings.evidenceJa: 今は兄さんに関わらないでください
findings.governingReading: please do not get involved with my brother now
findings.explanation: An English-only page inserts a prior promise by Shinji not to hit Sakura and Shirou’s explicit rage.

findings.highlight: I fell when Nii-san bumped into me
findings.evidenceJa: 兄さん、昨日の夜からおかしいんです
findings.governingReading: her brother has been acting strangely since last night
findings.explanation: The second English-only page supplies a revised cover story in which Shinji bumps Sakura down the stairs.

findings.highlight: Sakura is defending her brother. If the person who got hit isn’t complaining, I definitely can’t
findings.evidenceJa: 桜には悟られないようにしなければならない
findings.governingReading: Shirou must keep Sakura from realizing the truth
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shirou’s concealment duty with an unbound judgment about Sakura defending Shinji and the victim’s silence limiting him.

findings.highlight: His rights as a Master were taken away
findings.evidenceJa: マスターでなくなり
findings.governingReading: he ceased to be a Master
findings.explanation: A lost magical status becomes revocation of legalistic “rights.”

findings.highlight: he was humiliated by his own grandfather
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐臓硯に罵倒された
findings.governingReading: he was viciously berated by his grandfather, Matou Zouken
findings.explanation: The English removes Zouken’s verbal act and turns its effect into generic humiliation.

findings.highlight: He must have taken out his anger on Sakura after he went home
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に対しての怒りは尋常なものではないだろう
findings.governingReading: his anger toward Shirou is probably extraordinary
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces a prediction about Shinji’s anger at Shirou with a factual inference that he abused Sakura after returning home.

findings.highlight: Nobody’s told her about her brother
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は何も知らない
findings.governingReading: Sakura knows nothing about her brother and the Matou secret
findings.explanation: The English invents an external failure to tell Sakura and fragments the object of her ignorance.

findings.highlight: Sakura is a convenient outlet for his violent personality
findings.evidenceJa: その凶行が、妹である桜に及ぶことだってあり得えないとは言い切れない
findings.governingReading: one cannot rule out Shinji’s mad or violent act reaching his sister Sakura
findings.explanation: A possibility is replaced in the mature branch by a categorical characterization of Sakura as an outlet and Shinji as inherently violent.

findings.highlight: Don’t say that
findings.evidenceJa: 迷惑なんて、そんなこと言うな
findings.governingReading: do not say that you are causing trouble
findings.explanation: Shirou’s direct rejection of Sakura as a burden is reduced to an unspecified prohibition.

findings.highlight: I’m the one who caused the trouble
findings.evidenceJa: 迷惑をかけているとしたらこっちだ
findings.governingReading: if anyone is causing trouble, it is Shirou
findings.explanation: A conditional reversal meant to relieve Sakura becomes a direct admission that Shirou caused the situation.

findings.highlight: I have to think of a way
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が今まで通りに過ごせる方法
findings.governingReading: a way for Sakura to keep living as she always has
findings.explanation: The English deletes one of Shirou’s two parallel goals: preserving Sakura’s ordinary daily life, not only her smile.

findings.highlight: A dismal air hangs over the rest of the morning
findings.evidenceJa: 朝食は暗い雰囲気のまま終わった
findings.governingReading: breakfast ends with the gloomy atmosphere unbroken
findings.explanation: mirror moon expands the mood from the meal to the remainder of the morning and removes its completion.

findings.highlight: You always tried to go there even when you were sick
findings.evidenceJa: この前だって体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした
findings.governingReading: the other day she tried to push herself despite feeling unwell
findings.explanation: One recent attempt to overexert herself becomes a habitual pattern of attending while sick.

findings.highlight: Sakura opens the door
findings.evidenceJa: ガラガラ、と音をたてて玄関が開かれる
findings.governingReading: the entrance door opens with a rattling sound
findings.explanation: The sound and passive event are replaced by explicit agency and the sound is omitted.

findings.highlight: walks right into the door
findings.evidenceJa: 豪快に、扉にぶつかった
findings.governingReading: collides spectacularly or forcefully with the door
findings.explanation: The collision remains, but its outsized comic force disappears.

findings.highlight: She holds the nose she banged onto the door
findings.evidenceJa: 正面衝突した鼻を押さえる
findings.governingReading: she holds the nose that took the head-on collision
findings.explanation: The English is awkward and loses the head-on impact.

findings.highlight: I’d die if you saw my nose bleeding
findings.evidenceJa: せんひゃいにはなぢなんてみられたら、しんじゃいます
findings.governingReading: I would die if Senpai saw me with a nosebleed, spoken through her struck nose
findings.explanation: The meaning survives, but mirror moon normalizes Sakura’s injury-distorted pronunciation and removes the voiced physical comedy.

findings.highlight: It doesn’t seem like it was Sakura’s usual clumsiness
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の不注意……というわけじゃなさそうだ
findings.governingReading: it does not appear that the collision was due to Sakura’s carelessness
findings.explanation: The English invents habitual clumsiness, weakening Shirou’s recognition that this incident may be medical.

findings.highlight: Sakura leaves
findings.evidenceJa: 今度こそ桜は玄関を後にした
findings.governingReading: this time Sakura finally leaves the entrance
findings.explanation: The English omits the contrast with her failed first attempt to leave.

findings.highlight: she’s suffering from mental exhaustion
findings.evidenceJa: もし疲れてるとしたら、それは体ではなく心の方だろう
findings.governingReading: if she is tired, it is probably her mind rather than her body
findings.explanation: A doubly hedged contrast becomes a confident psychological diagnosis.

findings.highlight: someone else at school who I could talk to about the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちと同じように学校に通っていて、聖杯戦争にも通じているようなヤツ
findings.governingReading: someone who attends school like them and also seems knowledgeable about the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: The English removes both the shared-student condition and Shirou’s uncertainty about the person’s knowledge.

findings.highlight: People like that don’t just conveniently appear out of nowhere
findings.evidenceJa: ひょこひょこ歩いてる筈ない
findings.governingReading: such a conveniently suitable person cannot simply be walking around
findings.explanation: mirror moon loses the comic walking verb that cues the immediately available Rin answer and instead invents appearing from nowhere.
